findings.title: Translated posts link to translations that do not exist

evidence.observed: 3 links on 3 pages (3 distinct targets); by language: th 1, tr 1, vi 1; 0 written by translation commits
evidence.expected: Links to the default-language post when the target has no translation

findings.title: Translated posts contain damaged internal links

evidence.observed: 54 links on 54 pages (54 distinct targets); by language: ar 3, de 3, es 3, fa 3, fr 3, id 3, it 3, ja 3, ...; 0 written by translation commits
evidence.expected: Each internal link exactly as in the original post, in the page's language when that translation exists

findings.title: Posts link to another language although a translation exists

evidence.observed: 731 links on 374 pages (27 distinct targets); by language: ar 43, de 43, es 43, fa 43, fr 43, id 43, it 43, ja 43, ...; 0 written by translation commits
evidence.expected: Internal links point at the post in the page's own language

findings.title: Posts link to blog pages that do not exist

evidence.observed: 81 links on 81 pages (81 distinct targets); by language: ar 5, de 5, es 5, fr 5, ja 5, ko 5, pt 5, ru 5, ...; 51 written by translation commits; 68 copied from the original post
evidence.expected: Every internal link points at a live page
